name: edgway-monorepo
description: Open-source, Kong-compatible API gateway on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.drift: pnpm --filter @edgway/docs generate && pnpm --filter @edgway/admin openapi && pnpm --filter @edgway/sdk run generate && pnpm --filter @edgway/gateway gen:plugins && pnpm --filter @edgway/admin gen:plugins && git status --short -- apps/docs/content apps/admin/openapi.json packages/sdk/src/generated apps/gateway/src/generated apps/admin/src/generated && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/docs/content apps/admin/openapi.json packages/sdk/src/generated apps/gateway/src/generated apps/admin/src/generated)"
scripts.gate:i18n: pnpm --filter @edgway/i18n run verify && pnpm --filter @edgway/i18n run generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/i18n/lang packages/i18n/src/generated && eslint .
